summary: The version test compares version strings using loose, strict, semver/semantic or pep440 schemes, each with different parsing rules.
questions: How do I compare software versions in Ansible?
What version schemes can the version test use?
How are pre-release tags handled in strict versions?
Which version type should I use for Python package versions?

answer_card.title: Compare versions with the version test
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.version` compares version strings. Schemes (`version_type`):
- `loose` (default): any format, simple rules, sometimes surprising
- `strict`: 2–3 numeric parts plus optional `a`/`b` pre-release; pre-release sorts lower
- `semver`/`semantic`: Semantic Versioning
- `pep440` (2.14+): Python PEP 440
